title: שיעור 3 | תרגול לפיצוח | דף עבודה - פקודת קלט

tasks.name: Exercise 1 - output trace with end
tasks.description: Trace the given code and complete the table of num values and output for different inputs.

tasks.name: Exercise 2 - circumference and area
tasks.description: Complete and write programs calculating circle circumference/area, triangle perimeter, and square perimeter/area.

tasks.name: Exercise 3 - average grade trace
tasks.description: Trace the given code and complete the table of grade1, grade2, grade3 and average for different inputs.

tasks.name: Exercise 4 - shirts total payment
tasks.description: Complete the code reading number of shirts at 15 NIS each and printing total payment.

tasks.name: Exercise 5 - three games total and change
tasks.description: Write a program reading three game prices, computing total and change from 100 NIS.

tasks.name: Exercise 6 - book registration
tasks.description: Write a program reading details of 3 books and printing a summary.

tasks.name: Exercise 7 - airline passenger registration
tasks.description: Write a program reading details of at least 2 passengers and printing a summary.

tasks.name: Exercise 8 - comic store invoice
tasks.description: Write a program reading purchase details and printing an invoice without credit card details.
